Title: Data Analyst - Benchmark and Fund Portfolios
Description: Your Team Responsibilities The Benchmark & Third-party Portfolio team is part of the Data Operations department. The team solves complex problems related to all aspects of data operations, extends critical product features by inventing and building analytics capabilities, and provides exceptional service to clients. The team provides services to all major product lines of MSCI, namely Index, Analytics, ESG, and Real Assets and is spread across the globe – US, Mexico, Hungary, and Philippines. https://careers.msci.com/life-at-msci Your Key Responsibilities Being a member of a highly skilled and motivated team of analysts that solves complex problems regarding all aspects of market data production including data sourcing, processing, loading, analysis, etc. Operation monitoring / maintenance, re-engineering and developing efficient and elegant processes to support the daily production of market data. Becoming a subject-matter expert with regards to 3rd Party Benchmarks and Portfolios, and its implementation on Analytics platforms. Leading large-scale critical data projects independently to extend capabilities and coverage, support internal and external clients with content expertise. Creating business specifications and cooperating with various cross functional teams (IT, Research, Product) on their execution and implementation. Maintaining, re-engineering, and developing efficient and elegant processes to support the daily production of portfolio data and build/manage metrics for that. Assisting with data visualization efforts, automatic report generation and metrics reporting. Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Data Science, Business, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field. CFA and/or FRM designation (or progress toward certification) is a plus. 0–5 years of relevant professional experience. Demonstrated interest in data management, financial markets, financial products, and risk management. Familiarity with programming languages and technical tools such as SQL, Python, R, Perl, and basic UNIX file administration is an advantage. Experience with data visualization and analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Spotfire) and version control systems such as Git is preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights. Strong organizational, administrative, and project management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively. Experience working in Agile environments or with Agile methodologies is desirable. About MSCI What we offer you Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing. Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces. A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results. A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients. Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development. Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles. We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum. At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry. MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates. MSCI Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Title: Becario de analisis de datos comerciales
Description: ¡Estamos buscando un(a) Analista de Inteligencia Comercial y Datos! 📊💼 ¿Te apasiona transformar grandes volúmenes de datos en estrategias comerciales ganadoras? ¿Dominas el lenguaje de los números pero también entiendes cómo motivar a una fuerza de ventas? ¡Esta oportunidad es para ti! En Fañabellaestamos en la búsqueda de un experto en datos con fuerte visión comercial para unirse a nuestro equipo de Planning Comercial. Tu misión principal será liderar la analítica de canales, optimizar la reportería automatizada y convertir datos complejos en dashboards accionables que impulsen la productividad. 🔥 ¿Cuáles serán tus principales retos? Optimización y Monitoreo: Supervisar el flujo total de datos del área, optimizando los procesos que ya están automatizados y garantizando la calidad de la información. De Datos a Dashboards: Extraer datos de repositorios ya estructurados para transformarlos en tableros dinámicos y manejables para la fuerza de ventas. Planeación Estratégica: Analizar KPIs clave (rotación, productividad, calidad de venta) para la planeación y diseño de incentivos comerciales y forecasts. Generación de Valor: Identificar desviaciones, levantar alertas tempranas y proponer proyectos e ideas innovadoras que mejoren la eficiencia operativa. 🛠️ ¿Qué buscamos en ti? Formación: Profesionales en Administración, Ingeniería, Actuaria o carreras afines. Experiencia: Hasta 2 años de experiencia previa, idealmente en el sector financiero, retail o áreas comerciales. Hard Skills (Indispensables): Excel Avanzado (¡las regresiones son pan de cada día!). Dominio sólido de SQL y Tableau o programa afin. Deseables: Conocimientos en Python, R o Minitab. Soft Skills: Alta capacidad analítica, proactividad, atención al detalle y excelente comunicación para trabajar de la mano con los equipos de operaciones y ventas. 💼 ¿Qué ofrecemos? Esquema híbrido Sueldo competitivo Prestaciones superiores a la ley Ambiente dinámico donde tus ideas y proyectos realmente se implementan. 📌 ¿Te interesa el reto ? Adjunta tu CV por este medio #DataAnalytics #CommercialAnalytics #SQL #Tableau #Python #Empleo #Productividad #IncentivosComerciales
